title: API server insecure port flag must be disabled
check_summary: Look for --insecure-port in the kube-apiserver command line; anything other than 0 is a finding.
fix_summary: Set --insecure-port=0 in the API server manifest.

title: Kubelet read-only port must be disabled
check_summary: Kubelet must not have --read-only-port set, and readOnlyPort in kubelet config must be 0 or absent.
fix_summary: Remove the flag and set readOnlyPort to 0 or remove it, then restart kubelet.

title: API server insecure bind address must not be set
check_summary: The API server manifest must not carry an --insecure-bind-address flag.
fix_summary: Remove the --insecure-bind-address value from the API server manifest.

title: API server anonymous authentication must be disabled
check_summary: Finding if kube-apiserver sets --anonymous-auth to true.
fix_summary: Set --anonymous-auth=false in the API server manifest.

title: Kubelet anonymous authentication must be disabled
check_summary: Kubelet must not pass --anonymous-auth, and its config must set authentication.anonymous.enabled to false.
fix_summary: Remove the flag, set anonymous.enabled false in kubelet config, restart kubelet.

title: Kubelet must enable explicit authorization
check_summary: Kubelet --authorization-mode must be present and equal to Webhook.
fix_summary: Set --authorization-mode=Webhook for the kubelet and restart it.

title: API server must use Node,RBAC authorization mode
check_summary: Finding if --authorization-mode is AlwaysAllow or not configured on the API server.
fix_summary: Set --authorization-mode=Node,RBAC in the API server manifest.

title: User-managed resources must be in dedicated namespaces
check_summary: Workloads in default, kube-public or kube-node-lease (other than the kubernetes service) are a finding.
fix_summary: Move such resources to dedicated user namespaces.
object_evidence: metadata.namespace of pods/deployments/services etc. in default, kube-public, kube-node-lease

title: Controller Manager must create unique service accounts per workload
check_summary: Finding if kube-controller-manager lacks --use-service-account-credentials or sets it false.
fix_summary: Set --use-service-account-credentials=true in the controller manager manifest.

title: Kubernetes dashboard must not be enabled
check_summary: Any pod labeled k8s-app=kubernetes-dashboard in any namespace is a finding.
fix_summary: Delete the kubernetes-dashboard deployment in kube-system.

title: Kubelet staticPodPath must not enable static pods
check_summary: Kubelet config must not set staticPodPath and the service must not use --pod-manifest-path.
fix_summary: Remove staticPodPath and --pod-manifest-path, then restart kubelet.
object_evidence: kubelet config staticPodPath / --pod-manifest-path; pods with kubernetes.io/config.source=file

title: API server audit logs must be enabled
check_summary: The API server manifest must set a valid --audit-policy-file; absent or invalid is a finding.
fix_summary: Set --audit-policy-file in the API server manifest to a valid policy.

title: API server must have an audit log path set
check_summary: Finding if --audit-log-path is not set on the API server.
fix_summary: Set --audit-log-path to a secure location and mount the host path if the API server runs as a pod.

title: Secrets must not be stored as environment variables
check_summary: Any pod, deployment or container env var sourced via secretKeyRef is a finding.
fix_summary: Move such secrets to mounted secret files or an external vault.

title: Kubernetes must separate user functionality
check_summary: User pods running in kube-system, kube-public or kube-node-lease are a finding.
fix_summary: Move user pods to user-specific namespaces.

title: PodSecurity admission must be enabled on static pods and kubelets
check_summary: Static pod manifests need feature-gates including PodSecurity=true; kubelet must not use --feature-gates on the command line and its config must enable PodSecurity.
fix_summary: Add PodSecurity=true to feature gates in manifests and kubelet config, remove kubelet --feature-gates flag, restart kubelet.
object_evidence: kube-system pod args --feature-gates; kubelet config featureGates

title: Kubernetes must have a pod security policy set
check_summary: On pre-1.25 clusters at least one PodSecurityPolicy must exist requiring non-root and non-zero group ranges; PSP is removed in 1.25 so Pod Security Admission applies instead.
fix_summary: Create a restricted policy (no privileged, no escalation, drop capabilities, no host namespaces, non-root) or use Pod Security Admission.

title: Controller Manager must disable profiling
check_summary: Finding if kube-controller-manager lacks --profiling or sets it true.
fix_summary: Set --profiling=false in the controller manager manifest.

title: Kubelet must enable kernel protection
check_summary: Kubelet must not use --protect-kernel-defaults flag and config protectKernelDefaults must be true.
fix_summary: Remove the flag, set protectKernelDefaults true in kubelet config, restart kubelet.

title: Cluster must use non-privileged host ports for user pods
check_summary: Pods in user namespaces mapping any host port below 1024 are a finding.
fix_summary: Use a service mapping to a non-privileged host port or change the image to use unprivileged ports.
